question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

GREGARIOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Sociable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gregarious"** refers to someone who is fond of socializing and enjoys the company of others; it describes a person who is sociable or outgoing. (मिलनसार)
 
 
• **Example:** John is a gregarious person who loves attending parties and meeting new people.
 
 
• **"Sociable"** is the synonym for gregarious, meaning someone who is friendly and enjoys social interactions. (सामाजिक)
 
 
• **Example:** She is very sociable and has a wide circle of friends.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **"gregarious"** is **"Sociable."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sociable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quiet** (शांत): Refers to someone who is calm and not talkative.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a quiet person who prefers to stay in his room and read books.
 
 
 
• **Shy** (संकोची): Refers to someone who feels nervous or timid in social situations.
 
 
• **Example:** She was too shy to join the conversation at the party.
 
 
 
• **Reserved** (अलग-थलग): Refers to someone who is not openly expressive and prefers to keep their thoughts private.
 
 
• **Example:** The reserved man rarely spoke about his personal life.
